ticker_news.title: Stock-Split Watch: Is Microsoft Next?
ticker_news.description: Microsoft is likely to initiate a stock split due to its significant growth under CEO Satya Nadella and its position in the Dow Jones Industrial Average, driven by its strong performance in cloud computing and artificial intelligence sectors.
ticker_news.author: Will Healy

ticker_news.title: Computer Vision in Healthcare Market Size Skyrockets at 35.25% CAGR by 2034
ticker_news.description: The global computer vision in healthcare market is projected to grow from $2.45 billion in 2024 to $49.26 billion by 2034, with a 35.25% CAGR, driven by AI advancements in medical imaging, diagnostics, and surgical robotics.
ticker_news.author: Towards Healthcare
